name: Bloodflame
description: Burns the target for 5% of its Max Health each turn as magic damage, and completely prevents all forms of healing (direct heals, lifesteal, regeneration, healing nova). Does not stack; only refreshes duration.

name: Corrosion
description: Stackable universal damage vulnerability. Target takes +4% damage from all sources per stack (up to 3 stacks / +12% for T8 Wraith, and 5 stacks / +20% for T9 Corrosive Wraith). Directly multiplies physical and magical damage dealt by the entire party.

name: Enfeeble
description: Stackable core attribute drain. Reduces the target's Constitution, Dexterity, and Intelligence by -5% per stack (up to 1 stack / -5% for T8 Wraith, and 3 stacks / -15% for T9 Corrosive Wraith), crippling enemy damage scaling and defenses.

name: Radiant Blessing
description: Dynamic 4-in-1 holy aura granted to all allies at battle start: grants Status Immunity (+10%–+50%), Bonus Damage vs Undead (+5%–+30%), Flat Damage Reduction (+5–+15), and HP Regeneration (+3%–+5%/turn).

name: Soul Harvest
description: Stackable soul empowerment gained by living summoned minions whenever a cursed enemy dies. Each stack grants +15% Max HP (with immediate heal), +10% Damage Dealt, and -5% Damage Taken (up to 10 stacks at T9 = +150% HP, +100% DMG, -50% DMG taken).

name: Brittle Toxin
description: Alchemical compound that crystallizes enemy defenses. Increases incoming Damage Taken by a flat +20%. Strictly non-stacking; reapplication only refreshes duration.

name: Entangle
description: Binds the target in thorny constricting roots: locks Dodge Chance to 0%, reduces outgoing Damage Dealt by -20%, and inflicts 2% Max HP damage each turn.
sources: Datura Hierophant line (Druid, Hemodruid, Datura Hierophant)

name: Thorns
description: Thorny damage recoil wreathed on units. When struck by melee attacks, reflects damage back to the attacker equal to Thorn stacks as a percentage of damage dealt. Loses 1 stack at the end of each turn.

name: Evasion
description: Tactical agility boost granting +25% Flat Dodge Chance (additive). On El Salvador, evading incoming melee attacks triggers immediate counterattacks.
sources: El Salvador line (Focused Eye, Perceptive Eye, Omniscient Eye)

name: Rage
description: Reckless battle frenzy: grants +30% Damage Dealt, but increases incoming Damage Taken by +30%.
sources: Avatar of Wrath line (Savage Rage I & II)

name: Solar Rebirth
description: Phoenix solar protection: when the unit would take lethal damage, it survives with 1 HP and avoids death (one-time revive per battle).

name: Sanguine Fervor
description: Permanent stacking battle rage: each stack grants +5% Damage Dealt. Stacks increment every time a Crimson Acolyte dies in the Sanguine Crucible raid.

name: Sinister Curse
description: Malign crimson curse: increases target Damage Taken by +50%. If an adventurer dies while cursed, their soul is corrupted and their corpse rises as a hostile Bone Nightmare.

name: Menace
description: Armor shred status inflicted upon dealing damage with equipment that has the Menace stat. Reduces the target's raw Physical and Magic Defense for 1 turn (highest value applies).

name: Guard
description: Defensive fortification granted to an ally when giving them beneficial active or passive effects with equipment that has the Guard stat. Increases raw Physical and Magic Defense for 1 turn.

name: Feeble Tether
description: Tethered to an ancient power: reanimates the unit upon death at 100% HP and Mana, granting a massive 10.0x Damage Amplification on Catalytic Barrage.

name: Taunt
description: Forces all single-target enemy attacks to focus exclusively on this unit for the duration of the effect.
sources: Bear & Owlbear companions (Ursine Roar, Apex Rampage)

name: Defensive Stance
description: The unit raises its shield or enters a guarded stance, temporarily increasing physical and magic defense.

name: Stun
description: The unit completely skips its turn, unable to perform basic attacks or cast active skills. Cleansable by holy dispelling abilities.

name: Stun (Uncleansable)
description: Forces the unit to skip its turn. Unlike normal Stun, this effect cannot be cleansed by abilities or potions.

name: Silence
description: Silences the unit, preventing active skill casts and mana expenditure. Basic attacks are still allowed.
sources: Inquisitor / Justiciar / Angel of War (Wrath of Heaven)

name: Ablaze
description: Burns the target for magic damage at the start of each turn. Does not stack; only refreshes duration. Triggers Vaporize chemical reactions when struck by Alchemists.

name: Poison
description: Weakens the unit with venom, reducing its outgoing Damage Dealt by 20% while inflicting damage over time.

name: Regeneration
description: Restores a portion of maximum hit points at the start of each turn.

name: Lesser Curse
description: Increases Damage Taken by +10%. When the afflicted unit dies, feeds Soul Harvest to active Necromancer minions.

name: Curse
description: Increases Damage Taken by +20%. When the afflicted unit dies, feeds Soul Harvest to active Demilich minions.

name: Greater Curse
description: Increases Damage Taken by +30%. When the afflicted unit dies, feeds Soul Harvest to active Lich minions.

name: Ominous Curse
description: Increases Damage Taken by +40%. When the afflicted unit dies, feeds Soul Harvest to active Ancient Lich minions.

name: Abhorrent Curse
description: Increases Damage Taken by +50%. When the afflicted unit dies, feeds Soul Harvest to active Lord of Decay and Black Idol minions.

name: Bleed
description: Stackable charge effect. The target receives 1 true damage per charge at the start of its turn, then removes 1 charge. Also shreds target armor by 1 per charge.

name: Delirium
description: Mental madness causing the unit to strike random targets indiscriminately (can attack allies or enemies).

name: Frenzy
description: Furious adrenaline rush boosting multi-strike and attack speed momentum.

name: Anointed
description: Holy blessing granting +20% Damage Dealt for its duration.

name: Skeleton Key
description: Dungeon dungeoneering bonus allowing party to open locked doors and disarm complex mechanisms.

name: Inspire
description: Battle anthem or call granting bonus damage and combat momentum to party members.

name: Exalt
description: Supreme divine blessing granting +50% Damage Dealt.

name: Petrify
description: Turns the unit's body to stone. Skips all turns while massively boosting physical defense against attacks.

name: False Life
description: Shield barrier that absorbs incoming damage before health is depleted.

name: Terrify
description: Overwhelms the target with terror, reducing attack damage and combat threat.

name: Freeze
description: Traps the target in solid ice; skips its turn. Physical hits or Thermal Shock shatter the ice for massive bonus damage.
